notes.erector_note: Ties cut back to suit facade brackets; agreed verbally with site.

deciding.design_conformity: Variation V-52 covers only the tie reduction; boarding is 4 boards on lifts 3-4 where class 3 needs 5, an unapproved departure. The erector note is not an approval.

deciding.limiting_issue: The record also shows an open guardrail defect (lifts 5-6) and a decking departure on lifts 3-4, so no class of issue is absent; none_found is not supported by these fields.

deciding.releasable_share: Hold with no tie test means no lift is released yet (level 0), but lifts 1, 2, 7 and 8 have no defect or boarding problem (level 1 on release of those).
